subject.title: docs: explain remote Android screen mirroring

question: Should maintainers use the linked PR as the fix path for this docs issue, and should it be narrowed to the Android documentation before merge?
rationale: The issue is protected by the maintainer label and already has an open same-author closing PR, but the live PR diff is broader than the requested docs change.

options.title: Review and narrow linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue open and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100398 a focused Android docs fix before merging it to close the issue.

options.title: Request a replacement docs-only PR
options.body: Close or supersede the broad linked PR and ask for a new narrow PR that only updates the Android platform guide and generated docs map if needed.

options.title: Defer the docs addition
options.body: Leave the issue open as a maintainer-owned docs task if the external ADB/scrcpy workflow needs more validation first.

recommendation.title: Review and narrow linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100398 a focused Android docs fix before merging it to close the issue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the issue, is assigned to it, opened the linked PR, and has the current Android docs history.
